knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The rescue starts at once with the planned method. Waiting, stillness and standing up are each unsafe responses.
The rescue plan with named people, method and equipment is a precondition for fall-arrest work. The other options do not provide a rescue.
A rescuer who falls or is suspended becomes a second casualty. The sources prefer a rescue method that avoids that.

practicalCriteria: Names the rescue plan components for a supplied job, with a named rescuer, the method and the equipment at the work location
Demonstrates the chosen rescue method on a supervised set-up with a trained rescuer in place
Stops the work when a supplied scenario has no safe rescue arrangement, and states the reason
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written rescue plan for a supplied job
stopWorkCriteria: No named rescuer and equipment at the work location means fall-arrest work does not start
A rescuer who would be exposed to a fall without protection stops the rescue until protected
